purpose: Define the editor-hosted asset workspace centered on source-to-runtime mapping, dockable panels, and infinite-canvas compatibility.

panels.role: browse all Havenwild source families, external roots, and runtime candidates
read-only 32px sheet view with mapped/unmapped indicators
ground, edge, wall, cliff face, occluder, overlay, collision, animation roles
asset family, type, socket, variant, generation template, metadata
preview against terrain, player scale, depth, traversal, and placement rules
save mapper project, export handoff, create publish candidate

greenCheckPolicy: green check beside a tile sheet means mapped-sheet metadata exists and resolves to that sheet; it is not equivalent to runtime publication
